goal.objective: On each admitted WorkerCoordinator opportunity, materialize the authority-neutral COSV packet for the latest jointly observed heartbeat reference, preserving a reconstructable state cache and deterministic gradient inputs without granting carrier or analytic authority.
success_predicates: The worker consumes only admitted local heartbeat/WorkerCoordinator state.
A new carrier reference produces a verified FULL or DELTA packet under receipts/cosv/live/**.
DELTA packets bind the previous packet SHA, unchanged-state root, current full-state root and deterministic gradient_inputs.
No GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is required or forwarded.
StegVerse remains primary and third-party runtime dependency is false.
failure_predicates: The worker mutates heartbeat carrier or worker authority state.
The worker fabricates a carrier reference not present in canonical live state.
A packet fails digest/state-root reconstruction or authority invariants.
A third-party runtime or NON-TV/TVC credential becomes required.

task.derivation_reason: The first live HB31 packet proved the manual integration. Recurring packet production is repeated dependency-bound work and therefore must move into the existing WorkerCoordinator rather than remain a chat observation step.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted WorkerCoordinator tick while the task remains active

completion.next_authorized_action: Bind this task through the existing v12 WorkerCoordinator. If the carrier has advanced beyond the latest persisted COSV packet, materialize and verify the next packet; otherwise emit NO_NEW_REFERENCE and remain active for the next admitted reference.
terminal_when: The broader COSV live integration goal is explicitly retired or superseded after required live gradient/introspection evidence is terminal; until then this packet producer remains a recurring active infrastructure task.
